name: Trackian Mcp Server
description:
Trackian MCP Plugin for Claude Code
This plugin connects Claude Code to your Trackian Marketing Analytics data via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Investigate marketing anomalies and query your analytics data from Claude Code.

Trackian connects Claude Code to your marketing data — GA4, Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Search Console, and your data warehouse. Ask Claude to investigate anomalies, generate, channel reports, or run deep analyses the way a data analyst would.
longDescription:
Ships **3 skills**, **3 agents** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (3): `analyze` (Perform deep data analysis on a project using natural language to SQL), `anomaly` (Investigate marketing anomalies for a specific project, metric, and date using Trackian Sentinel agents), `report` (Generate a comprehensive channel performance report for a specific project and date range)
- **Agents** (3): `critical-agent`, `sentinel-investigator`, `summarization-agent`
- **MCP servers** (1): `trackian`

Installs with `claude plugin install trackian-mcp-server@claude-community` from `trackian/claude-plugin`.
